verdict.rationale: Live probes confirm Stripe serves a real llms.txt at docs.stripe.com/llms.txt with agent-directed instructions, and every docs page is available as a raw .md file (payments.md, mcp.md, etc.). Stripe also publishes agent-oriented material on top of that: a keyless .well-known skills index with 8 maintained skills, a docs-search tool in its MCP server, and copy-paste coding-agent prompts that point agents at .md docs. That covers the story as written, with both first-party documentation and hands-on corroboration.
